subject.title: fix(huggingface): bound model-discovery JSON response via shared provider reader

question: Should Hugging Face model discovery use the shared 16 MiB provider JSON cap and fall back to the static catalog when that cap is exceeded?
rationale: The patch is correct and defensive, but it intentionally changes the behavior for unusually large successful discovery responses, which is a compatibility boundary maintainers should accept explicitly.

options.title: Accept the shared cap
options.body: Land this focused PR with the existing 16 MiB provider JSON limit and static-catalog fallback for overflow, then make the broader sweep skip or rebase this path.

options.title: Ask for full changed-path proof
options.body: Request one additional terminal proof that calls `discoverHuggingfaceModels` against a streamed oversized local `/models` server before merge.

options.title: Defer to the broad sweep
options.body: Keep this PR paused only if maintainers want https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98941 to own Hugging Face plus the other success-path reads together.

recommendation.title: Accept the shared cap
recommendation.body: Land this focused PR with the existing 16 MiB provider JSON limit and static-catalog fallback for overflow, then make the broader sweep skip or rebase this path.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest feature-specific history points to prior Hugging Face discovery work by @steipete, and the decision is about that provider's discovery fallback behavior.
